Class CompileEvent

java.lang.Object
com.group22.reportnow.model.TelemetryEvent
com.group22.reportnow.model.CompileEvent
public class CompileEvent extends TelemetryEvent
Stores information about a compilation attempt in BlueJ. Records whether it succeeded, how long it took and any errors.

    • CompileEvent

      public CompileEvent(long timestampMs, String projectName, boolean success, long durationMs, List<CompileError> errors)
      Creates an event containing the results of a compilation.
      Parameters:
      timestampMs - the time the event happened in milliseconds
      projectName - the name of the project
      success - whether the compilation was successful
      durationMs - how long the compilation took in milliseconds
      errors - the errors and warnings found during compilation
